# KISFIT Studio (kisfitglobal.com)
> 100% automated, non-medical US CDC 2000 child growth percentile calculator & printable parent reference studio (zero supplement ads).

## Primary Free Tools & Public Tables
- Free 60-Second US CDC Growth & Bone-Age Check: https://kisfitglobal.com/
- 15 US CDC 2000 Child Height Percentile Charts & Parent Guides Hub: https://kisfitglobal.com/cdc-height-chart/
- Free 2-Page US CDC Sample Report PDF: https://kisfitglobal.com/assets/downloads/kfg_sample_2p.pdf
- Mid-Parental Height vs US CDC Curve Guide: https://kisfitglobal.com/cdc-height-chart/mid-parental-height-vs-cdc-curve.html
- Elapsed Bone-Age Time-Lag Guide: https://kisfitglobal.com/cdc-height-chart/bone-age-gap-time-lag-guide.html

## Public Data Sources & Scope
- Public US CDC 2000 Stature-for-Age LMS reference tables (ages 2-18). Educational parent tool for adults (18+); not medical advice.
